ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity pixels (white/light grey) to 15% low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous area across both lobes; central dark-intensity cluster originating from the peduncle attachment point, tapering upwards into a triangular shape; thin, continuous low-intensity boundary along the trailing edge; several small, isolated dark-intensity focal points scattered on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 48 degrees; depth is significant, extending roughly 12% into the vertical fluke plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth trailing edge with low-amplitude undulating variations; lack of high-frequency jagged serrations; minor irregularities visible as small peaks near the median notch and distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal trajectory; initially convex from the peduncle, transitioning to a long, straight to slightly concave sweep towards the outer extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of at least five small, circular dark-intensity spots (approximately 5-10 pixels in diameter) localized on the medial-right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, parallel diagonal linear disruptions detected on the lower right lobe, consistent with rake mark patterning.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark pigmentation at the center-base; large clusters of high-contrast, irregular protrusions (consistent with barnacle colonization) located at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of external bio-fouling organisms on the lateral fluke tips creating a jagged, non-biological silhouette compared to the smoother surrounding edge.
